description.value:
Your cosmo answers not only to your own star but to the ones beside it.

On any day one of the two constellations adjacent to yours in the zodiac is ascendant, you gain your Ascendant Boon at half effect: halve any bonus, extra damage die, extra action, or emanation radius it grants (minimum 1 where the boon grants a number), and any frequency of once per round becomes once per minute.

If an adjacent sign rises Exalted, you gain your Ascendant Boon at full effect instead of your Zenith Boon. Your own sign rising always takes precedence.

Design note: this feat is listed in the class guide's feat table but was never written up. The rules here are a first pass from its one-line description and are the most likely thing in this module to want a second look.
